# Section 9: Limitations, References, and AI Acknowledgement

## 9.1 Assumptions and Limitations
- All satellite telemetry, tracking, and ground-station link metrics are synthetic educational abstractions.
- Memory page sizes and segment limits are scaled for demonstration and do not reflect specific flight avionics microcontrollers.
- The machine learning router is trained on synthetic heuristic policy labels with injected noise.

## 9.2 References
1. Silberschatz, A., Galvin, P. B., & Gagne, G. *Operating System Concepts* (10th ed.). Wiley.
2. Dijkstra, E. W. "Cooperating Sequential Processes". Technological University, Eindhoven.
3. POSIX.1-2017 standard IEEE Std 1003.1-2017 (pthreads, semaphores, mutexes).

## 9.3 AI Tool Acknowledgement
Code scaffolding, build configuration templates, and structural documentation were developed with assistance from Google Antigravity / Gemini code assistant. All algorithmic logic, synchronization semantics, memory mappings, and viva explanations were reviewed, verified, and understood by the team members.
